scripts.check: pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:sdk && pnpm run check:docs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:sdk
scripts.test:core: cargo test -p ballista-common -p ballista -p ballista-sdk --features ballista-common/proptest
scripts.fixtures: UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 pnpm --dir clients/js exec vitest run src/fixtures.test.ts src/protocol-examples.test.ts
scripts.benchmarks: pnpm --dir clients/js exec vitest run src/benchmarks.test.ts && UPDATE_BENCHMARKS=1 cargo test --manifest-path tests/ballista/Cargo.toml -- measure_every_example profile_compute_units && node scripts/benchmark-tables.mjs
scripts.test:devnet: BALLISTA_DEVNET=1 pnpm --dir clients/js exec vitest run src/devnet-offsets.test.ts
scripts.build:program:profiled: cargo build-sbf --manifest-path programs/ballista/Cargo.toml --features cu-profile && cp target/deploy/ballista.so target/deploy/ballista-cu-profile.so && cargo build-sbf --manifest-path programs/ballista/Cargo.toml
scripts.cu:phases: pnpm run build:program:profiled && UPDATE_BENCHMARKS=1 cargo test --manifest-path tests/ballista/Cargo.toml --features cu-profile -- --nocapture phase_profile && node scripts/benchmark-tables.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:program && pnpm run build:sdk
